subject: Request: temporary log buffer and DPA amendment for audit
messages:
From: Jane Harper <jane.harper@healthsync.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary log buffer request + DPA amendment for upcoming audit

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from Legal Ops — HealthSync has a regulatory audit starting 2027-05-23 that will require us to produce server-side request logs and backup snapshots for a rolling 18-month window. Our current contract with Redwood lists the standard 90-day log retention and a 12-month backup slice. The auditors are requesting evidence of certain debug logs and backup manifests that fall outside these windows.

Can Redwood provide a temporary buffer/hold for the affected log buckets and delay scheduled backup purges for a subset of customers (HealthSync) for 60 days beyond the normal schedule? We understand this is an exception; please advise on:
- feasibility and any technical constraints (which subsystems would be impacted)
- whether Redwood needs a DPA amendment or Addendum to cover this longer retention and the cross-border transfer of snapshot copies to our EU counsel
- an estimate of cost or procurement steps if there is a fee

Appreciate a point of contact and timeline so we can present to audit steering.

Thanks,
Jane Harper
Legal Operations — HealthSync
legalops@healthsync.com

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Harper <jane.harper@healthsync.com>, Legal Ops <legalops@healthsync.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 15:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary log buffer request + DPA amendment for upcoming audit

Jane — thanks for the heads up and the clear ask. We can support a scoped temporary hold for HealthSync logs and backups; below is an initial runbook and open questions. I’ve looped in Kimberly (legal) and Karthik (operations) to confirm constraints and any downstream procurement needs.

What we can offer (high level):
- Short-term retention extension: pause scheduled purge tasks for the specified S3 buckets and log indices for +60 days beyond the normal deletion date for records within the audit scope.
- Escrow snapshot: take an immutable snapshot (WORM) exported to a locked object store and provide manifest CSVs for auditor ingestion.
- Access & transfers: we can export a copy to eu-west-1 for your EU counsel, but will need a DPA amendment to record that transfer and subprocessors involved.

Open questions for HealthSync:
1) Exact indices/buckets and sample keys to scope the exception (we prefer a minimal set).
2) Whether encrypted snapshots must be shared directly with your counsel or via Redwood-managed escrow.
3) Target start date for the hold and the end date (you asked to cover the audit; we typically propose start ASAP and end = 60 days after auditors close).

Next steps I’ll take:
- Karthik: will validate capacity impact and provide a short impact memo (disk usage, estimated extra cost).
- Kimberly: will draft an emergency DPA addendum and list subprocessors for the transfer.
- I’ll create a short checklist and manifest template and share a DocuSign link for approval once legal has the addendum ready.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_temp_retain_checklist.pdf (stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Capacity impact for HealthSync temporary retain (internal)

Marissa / Kimberly — quick ops readout for the proposed +60d hold.

Summary: we can implement a scoped pause to purge jobs on the requested buckets and log indices for HealthSync. Impact: estimated additional storage of ~2.2 TB for 60 days (based on HealthSync’s current ingestion), which is within our cluster headroom but will increase snapshot export egress for the escrow copy.

Technical notes / constraints:
- We’ll need the exact bucket prefixes and index patterns by EOD 2027-05-04 to avoid the next scheduled purge run (2027-05-06 02:00 UTC).
- The WORM export to eu-west-1 requires use of our S3 transfer subprocessor (TransMux); this subprocessor will hold its own retention/replication settings — we must list them in the DPA addendum.
- We can create an immutable snapshot manifest (CSV) and sign it; manifest will include object keys, checksums, and a timestamp.

Additional cost: negligible for storage headroom (<$250 one-time ops), egress charges for export estimated ~$420 based on 1.5 TB. Procurement should approve a one-off operational fee if HealthSync requires Redwood to pay for transfer.

I’ll prepare the ops checklist and the manifest template (escrow_snapshot_manifest.csv) and push to the shared drive link.

—Karthik
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: escrow_snapshot_manifest.csv (template)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA addendum and subprocessors list (HealthSync)

Marissa / Karthik — drafted a short DPA addendum for the temporary retain and export to EU counsel. Key points covered:
- Scope limited to the object prefixes and indices HealthSync enumerates; addendum auto-expires 60 days after auditors close or 2027-08-01, whichever is earlier.
- Explicit subprocessors: TransMux (transfer), ImmutableStoreCo (escrow), and RedAudit (signed manifest verifier).
- Cross-border transfer legal basis: Standard Contractual Clauses with appropriate safeguards; we’ll append a subprocessors exhibit listing contact and SOC attestations.
- Emergency hold procedure: Redwood will pause purge jobs upon signed addendum + PO or confirmation of cost approval; we’ll include a rollback/rollback-notice timeline in the runbook.

I’ve attached the draft (dpa_amend_draft.docx). If Legal Ops approves, we can send the DocuSign flow; please flag any additional subprocessors to include.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: dpa_amend_draft.docx (draft)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Harper <jane.harper@healthsync.com>, Legal Ops <legalops@healthsync.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Temporary log buffer request + DPA amendment for upcoming audit — confirmation and next steps

Jane — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal review we can proceed with the scoped temporary retention and export. Summary of agreed items: 

1) Scope: HealthSync will provide exact S3 prefixes and index patterns by EOD 2027-05-04. Redwood will pause purge jobs for those keys and take an immutable snapshot.
2) Duration: retention will be extended by +60 days after the normal purge date; addendum expiry set to 60 days after audit close (auto-expire 2027-08-01 as a safe guard).
3) Subprocessors & transfer: stated in the DPA addendum; export will use TransMux and ImmutableStoreCo.
4) Costs: ops storage headroom negligible; egress/export estimated ~$420. If HealthSync requires Redwood to cover transfer costs, Procurement will raise a one-off PO.
5) Legal: Kimberly has prepared the addendum; link to draft & DocuSign below.

Action items for HealthSync (please confirm):
- Provide exact prefixes/index patterns and confirmation of recipient EU counsel (name and email) by 2027-05-04 EOD.
- Confirm whether HealthSync will accept the estimated export cost or if Redwood should cover it.
- Sign the DPA addendum via DocuSign (link below) after internal approval.

DocuSign: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/HS-TempRetain-2027
Shared drive (ops artifacts & manifest template): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/temporary-retain/HealthSync

If HealthSync confirms the prefixes today we can intercept the purge run scheduled 2027-05-06 02:00 UTC and create the snapshot before it runs.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_temp_retain_checklist.pdf, dpa_amend_draft.docx, escrow_snapshot_manifest.csv
